repository.purpose: Small in-memory transaction manager CLI (demo-app/app.py) that validates transactions, computes net total and average, finds duplicates, applies discounts and retrieves records by position.

bugs.title: find_duplicates returns originals and overwrites the store
bugs.expected: Returns valid records whose id appeared earlier (originals excluded), in insertion order; store unchanged.
bugs.expected_behaviour_source: demo-app/EXPECTED_BEHAVIOUR.md find_duplicates section + CLI table (summary: 1 duplicate); tests test_find_duplicates_*
bugs.actual: Returns first occurrence of each id and assigns self._transactions = unique, deleting duplicate and invalid records.

reproduction.result_before_fix: Returns first occurrences ([A,B,C] for A,B,A,C); count drops 4->3; CLI duplicates prints 4 lines; summary shows 4 duplicates.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: find_duplicates collects ids not yet seen (the originals) instead of ids already seen, and then assigns that list back to self._transactions, destroying duplicate and invalid records. Symptoms: CLI summary/duplicates.

fix.summary: Collect valid records whose id is already in `seen` into a new list; drop the `self._transactions = unique` assignment.

verification.full_suite: 34 failed, 49 passed; all failures belong to unfixed defects BH-002..BH-008; no baseline-passing test regressed

bugs.title: total_valid_transactions adds abs(amount), refunds raise the total
bugs.expected: Sum of signed amounts; 100,-30,50 -> 120.0; sample summary net total 501.25.
bugs.root_cause: Root cause: the loop adds abs(tx['amount']), discarding the sign of refunds. Symptom: CLI summary net total 541.25.

verification.full_suite: 30 failed, 53 passed; all failures belong to unfixed defects; no baseline-passing test regressed

bugs.title: get_transaction raises or returns wrong record for invalid index
bugs.expected: Non-integer, negative or >= count() index returns None; never raises.
bugs.expected_behaviour_source: demo-app/EXPECTED_BEHAVIOUR.md get_transaction section; CLI table show 99; tests test_get_transaction_*
bugs.actual: IndexError for out-of-range, record from end for negative, TypeError for non-int.

reproduction.result_before_fix: IndexError for 4, -5, 10**400 and empty store; -1/-4 return records from the end; TypeError for '1', 1.5, None; CLI show 99 crashes, show -1 prints the unlabelled receipt.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: get_transaction indexes the list directly, so Python's negative indexing, IndexError and TypeError leak through; no type or range check exists. Symptom: CLI show 99 traceback, show -1 shows the last record.

fix.summary: Return None unless index is an int with 0 <= index < len(self._transactions); then index the list.

verification.full_suite: 18 failed, 65 passed; all failures belong to unfixed defects; no baseline-passing test regressed

bugs.notes: Decision: spec does not say whether bool counts as an integer index; isinstance(index, int) is used, so True/False behave as 1/0 (Python semantics). User to confirm.

bugs.title: average_transaction_value raises ZeroDivisionError with no valid records
bugs.expected: Returns 0.0 with no valid transactions; never raises.
bugs.expected_behaviour_source: demo-app/EXPECTED_BEHAVIOUR.md average_transaction_value section; CLI table --empty summary; test_average_of_empty_store_is_zero

reproduction.result_before_fix: ZeroDivisionError for empty store and only-invalid store; CLI --empty summary crashes.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: total / len(valid) has no guard for an empty valid list. Symptom: CLI --empty summary crash.

fix.summary: Return 0.0 when there are no valid transactions, before dividing.

verification.full_suite: 15 failed, 68 passed; all failures belong to unfixed defects; no baseline-passing test regressed

bugs.title: apply_discount does not reject percent outside 0-100
bugs.evidence: no range check before amount * (1 - percent / 100)

reproduction.result_before_fix: apply_discount(200,150/-10/100.01/-0.01) returns a number instead of raising ValueError.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: apply_discount never checks the percent range.

fix.summary: Raise ValueError when percent < 0 or percent > 100 before computing.

verification.full_suite: 11 failed, 72 passed; all failures belong to unfixed defects BH-006..BH-008; no baseline-passing test regressed

bugs.title: currency check accepts any 3-character string
bugs.expected: Currency must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters.
bugs.expected_behaviour_source: demo-app/EXPECTED_BEHAVIOUR.md Data model table (currency) + validate_transaction 'every rule ... is checked'

reproduction.result_before_fix: usd, Usd, US1, ÄBC, full-width USD and 'U D' are accepted; tx(' ', True, 'usd') yields 2 problems instead of 3.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: the currency check tests only type and length 3; it never checks that each character is an uppercase ASCII letter.

fix.summary: Also require every character to be in 'A'..'Z' within the same single rule (one problem).

verification.full_suite: 4 failed, 79 passed; all failures belong to unfixed BH-007/BH-008; no baseline-passing test regressed

bugs.title: validate_transaction raises OverflowError for a huge int amount

reproduction.result_before_fix: validate_transaction(amount=±10**400) raises OverflowError: int too large to convert to float.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: math.isnan/math.isinf convert the amount to float, which raises OverflowError for ints beyond float range; validate_transaction has no handling for that.

fix.summary: Convert the amount with float() under `except OverflowError` only, and report such amounts as 'amount must be finite'.

bugs.notes: Decision: spec says amounts are floats and must be finite but does not say whether an int too large for a float is valid. Chosen: treat it as not finite (one 'amount must be finite' problem). Satisfies 'never raises' for validate and average. User to confirm.

bugs.title: average_transaction_value can raise OverflowError for huge int amounts
bugs.expected: Never raises for a store that holds only dictionaries.
bugs.expected_behaviour_source: demo-app/EXPECTED_BEHAVIOUR.md average_transaction_value: 'Never raises for a store that holds only dictionaries.'
bugs.evidence: total / len(valid) with total = 10**400 raises 'integer division result too large for a float' if such an amount is treated as valid.

reproduction.result_before_fix: average_transaction_value on a store with amount 10**400 raises OverflowError (currently from the BH-007 path in validate_transaction). After attempt 1 (no separate change): 10**308, 10**308, 1.0 still raised OverflowError: int too large to convert to float.

bugs.root_cause: Root cause: average_transaction_value sums with sum(...) starting from int 0, so leading int amounts accumulate as an exact int; when a float follows, converting an int total above ~1.8e308 to float raises OverflowError, even though every amount individually passes BH-007 validation. Not a secondary failure of BH-007 (the orchestrator's original Phase 4 classification was wrong; caught by the test-engineer review).

fix.summary: Sum as floats: sum((tx['amount'] for tx in valid), 0.0), so overflow yields inf instead of raising.

bugs.notes: Attempt 1 (no separate change, relying on BH-007) was recorded as Verification passed on the original tests, which only used amounts BH-007 now rejects. The test-engineer review showed the remaining path; status corrected to Verification failed. Attempt 2 changes the summation.

observations.reason_not_a_defect: Starts from 0.0, so it never raises (checked: returns inf). Spec does not define the value for an overflowing total. Original observation that it could raise was wrong and was corrected after review.
